title: Couples relationship coaching app
summary: An app that helps couples communicate and stay connected.
whyTempting: Relationships matter and therapy is expensive.
whyItFails: Both partners must engage. Usually one partner is keen. Crisis use. People come when things are bad, then leave. Stigma. Admitting relationship trouble is hard.
whatWouldChange: AI-guided exercises cheap enough to use preventively.

attempts.outcome: Shut down two years after launch
attempts.notes: Meta's private messaging app for couples.
